title: 園芸用のじょうろ
description: 花壇・温室・公園管理小屋向けのじょうろ。空洞のある楕円の胴と開いた給水口、上の弓形持ち手、後ろの傾け用持ち手、中空の注ぎ口、19個の貫通穴を持つ散水口を造形。水や流れ、可動機構はなく、内部の流体経路や散水性能は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.300 × 0.479 × 0.658 m、6,874三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A watering can for flower beds, greenhouses and park-maintenance sheds, with a hollow oval vessel and open fill port, high arched carrying handle, rear pouring handle, hollow spout and rose with 19 actual through-holes. Water, flow and articulation are absent; internal fluid routing and watering performance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.300 × 0.479 × 0.658 m; 6,874 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
